name: herdr-bridge
description: Route WebSearch, YouTube fetches and large reports to other agents (agy, pi, hermes, a local model) through herdr, and track Claude token usage to compare.

configPath.title: Config file
configPath.description: Path to the routing config (JSON). Empty: <project>/.claude/herdr-bridge.json, then ~/.claude/herdr-bridge.json.

mode.title: Default routing mode
mode.description: on: routes apply. off: every tool runs natively; token tracking continues, for A/B comparison. /bridge on|off overrides it.

dataDir.title: Data directory
dataDir.description: Where the token ledger and agent hand-off files go. Empty: ~/.claude/herdr-bridge.

showBand.title: Show the band above the prompt
showBand.description: A one-line summary of this session's Claude tokens and delegations.
